title: Site Model — registry/launchd-writers.yml
description: One writer per launchd label prefix, CI-enforced (§4.1, from the tooling review). Kills the two-writers hazard at the source: a promise that would write outside CFEngine's declared prefix fails the lint before it reaches the machine. This is the safety rail that makes §12 Step 1 survivable on the operator's daily driver.

domain.description: The launchd label namespace, as a domain of device state (D16(d)). Comprehensive means: any loaded launchd job whose label matches no declared prefix is reported as an extra entry.

prefix.description: Reverse-DNS label prefix ending in `.*`, e.g. `com.stayturgid.*`. bin/schema_lint.py additionally rejects a prefix nested inside another — two writers over one namespace is exactly the hazard this file exists to prevent, and nesting is how it comes back.

writer.description: The single tool permitted to write labels under this prefix.

repo.description: Where that writer's definition lives, when it is ours.
